pages.title: Heat Death Remnant
pages.text: All that is left of a universe that has reached maximum entropy: no stars, no gradients, nothing to drive any process at all. It is cold, perfectly even and perfectly still, a uniform grey with no texture to catch the light. Holding it feels like holding silence.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I let a Pocket Universe in the Universe Forge run to its end. Trillions of years compressed into a few minutes, and the bubble came out like this: inert, even, and oddly peaceful. Its stillness is what makes new universes possible.
